deliverables.title: In-class Participation (iClicker polls)
deliverables.notes: Graded on completion based on percentage of questions answered. At least 80% = 5/5; 70–79% = 4/5; 60–69% = 3/5; 50–59% = 2/5; 40–49% = 1/5; Less than 40% = 0. Specific poll dates on OWL.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: No specific dates given; participation is ongoing throughout the semester per OWL.

deliverables.title: Quizzes (best 6 of 8)
deliverables.notes: 8 quizzes administered through WebWork; best 6 count. Dates on OWL. Partially cumulative. First 2 missed quizzes do not require Academic Consideration.

deliverables.notes: In-person, closed-book, 120-minute written test. Covers weeks 1–6. Mix of multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blanks, matching, and short-answer. No calculators or aids permitted. Make-up tentatively scheduled Friday, March 6 from 7–9 pm.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: In-person, closed-book, 180-minute written exam. Covers all course material. No calculators or aids permitted. Scheduled by the Registrar's Office during April 12–30, 2026 exam period.
